card.name: Ambassador term dates and diplomatic words
card.fires_on: The start of a year (the 1 in 1978, or the space before it) in lists of ambassador appointment and departure dates. It also fires on the words diplomatic, diplomats and Dipl in diplomacy settings.

modes.label: Years in ambassador lists
modes.description: The first digit of a year, or the space before it, in appointment, credentials and termination dates of ambassadors.

modes.label: Diplomacy words
modes.description: The words diplomatic, diplomats or the start of Diplomats in text about foreign relations.
modes.example: The United States has not accorded full<< diplomatic>> recognition to North Vietnam

card.writes: It pushes the model toward diplomacy words such as diplomatic, diplomat and negotiate.
card.plain: It lights up on ambassador service dates and on words about diplomats and diplomatic relations.
